recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中顆粒球系為主，數顆成熟嗜中性球細胞質淡粉、幾乎無顆粒（hypogranular），核分葉異常或呈環形／扭曲；上方有一顆周邊充滿粗大深色顆粒的細胞（嗜鹼性球系），整體呈現 aCML 常見的顆粒球發育不良。
features: Predominance of granulocytic precursors: myelocytes and metamyelocytes with round to kidney-shaped nuclei
Several neutrophils with pale, hypogranular cytoplasm and abnormal nuclear segmentation (twisted/ring-like, hyposegmented forms)
Upper-center cell with coarse dark basophilic granules concentrated at the periphery (basophil lineage)
Occasional small dark erythroid precursor and a larger cell with blue cytoplasm and eccentric nucleus
Background of platelets and granular debris overlying red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a granulocyte-predominant population of myelocytes, metamyelocytes and neutrophils. Several mature neutrophils display hypogranular pale cytoplasm and abnormal nuclear segmentation, including twisted/ring-like and hyposegmented forms, consistent with dysgranulopoiesis. A cell with coarse dark basophilic granules is present at the top of the field, and scattered erythroid precursors are seen. No increase in blasts is apparent in this field. The findings of granulocytic predominance with dysgranulopoiesis are consistent with atypical CML in the appropriate BCR::ABL1-negative context.

ddx.vs: CML granulocytes are normally granulated without dysplasia, with prominent basophils/eosinophils and dwarf megakaryocytes; BCR::ABL1 separates them.
MDS shows similar dysgranulopoiesis but with peripheral cytopenias rather than neutrophilic leukocytosis.
CMML shows increased monocytes and promonocytes, confirmed by nonspecific esterase and blood monocytosis.
Reactive marrows show normally granulated neutrophils with toxic granulation rather than hypogranular, abnormally segmented forms.
